items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses the coincidence of names between his father (Henry William) and the interviewer's father (William Henry), but does not describe a personal relationship with William Henry himself.

ctx.x: Share with us some of the things that you talked with us about last night period he were talking about the similarities between your two families. You were talking about your dad…

About the similarities. Remember how there were 10 in your family and they were 10 at one time in my family and so forth? My father's name was Henry William and your father's name was William Henry? Her father's name was Henry. My father's name was Henry William.
It coincidence with the William Henry and the Henry William.
